title: UE5 Source-First Implementation
description: Before writing ANY engine code, ALWAYS read the corresponding UE5 source at W:\UE_5.6_Source first. Use unreal-architect agent to find the exact file, function, and line number. Implement the SAME math with only variable/function name changes to avoid copyright. Document the UE5 source reference in code comments.
whenToUse: Every time any rendering, lighting, fog, shadow, physics, or post-processing code is written or modified.
whenNotToUse: Pure engine infrastructure (memory allocators, file I/O, build system) that has no UE5 equivalent.
